items.title: File lawsuit (Klage) against rejection of building permit
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie binnen eines Monats nach seiner Bekanntgabe Klage beim Bayerischen Verwaltungsgericht Musterregensburg, Haidplatz 4, 93047 Musterregensburg erheben, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Geschäftsstelle des Gerichts.
items.computation: Letter dated Wed 18.11.2026, sent by ordinary post. The letter itself states the 4-day deemed-delivery rule (Art. 41 Abs. 2 BayVwVfG): 18.11.2026 + 4 days = Sun 22.11.2026; this deemed-delivery day is not shifted for weekends. The one-month Klage period starts the next day (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB) and ends one month later under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, i.e. on the day with the same number as the day of the triggering event: 22.12.2026 (Tuesday) — a normal business day in Bayern, so no further shift is needed. Note: if this building application was already pending before 1 January 2025, Bavaria's transitional rule (Art. 98 BayVwVfG) could still apply the older 3-day deemed-delivery rule instead, which would move deemed delivery to Sat 21.11.2026 and the deadline to Mon 21.12.2026 — the earlier, safer date to aim for is therefore 21.12.2026, though the letter's own text points to 22.12.2026 under the 4-day rule it quotes.

warnings: The 120 € fee for the rejection will be billed separately in a future 'Kostenbescheid' (Gebührenbescheid); no payment date is set by this letter, so no payment item was created — watch for that follow-up notice and check its own deadline and IBAN when it arrives.

The letter states the 4-day deemed-delivery rule (Art. 41 Abs. 2 BayVwVfG); if the underlying building application was pending before 1 January 2025, Bavaria's older 3-day transitional rule (Art. 98 BayVwVfG) could instead apply, moving the Klage deadline one day earlier to 2026-12-21 — to be safe, do not wait past 15–16 December 2026 to file or post the Klage.
No Widerspruch is available ('Ein Widerspruchsverfahren ist in dieser Sache nicht vorgesehen') — only direct Klage to the Verwaltungsgericht Musterregensburg within the one-month period.
No instructions addressed to an AI or automated system were found in the letter text.
